svg.title: Timeline: UK digital ID — proposal to Burnham reversal (Sep 2025–Jul 2026)
svg.desc: Vertical timeline of five anchored events: Sep 2025 original mandatory proposal; 13 Oct 2025 Commons right-to-work statement; 15 Jan 2026 dilution to voluntary infrastructure; 10 Mar 2026 consultation; 18 Jul 2026 Burnham scrap pledge.

svg.text: Nuance: by Jan–Mar 2026 the public-facing scheme was already voluntary; Burnham is reversing a diluted plan,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, Cascadia Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: not an intact mandatory universal ID. Mandatory drop after backlash is confirmed but undated (before Jan 2026).
